license.detector_checkpoint: Ultralytics describes YOLO models under AGPL-3.0 or Enterprise licensing. The TorchSig release does not separately clarify checkpoint-specific terms; do not infer MIT weights licensing from the repository.

task: wideband signal detection on spectrogram images

preprocessing.input: one-dimensional complex IQ plus sample rate and RF center frequency
preprocessing.spectrogram: TorchSig v2.1.1 compute_spectrogram pattern: periodic Blackman, unnormalized FFT power, FFT shift, relative epsilon for exact zeros, 10 log10, frequency rows reversed high-to-low and time columns; default n_fft=256, hop=128, no padding for complete msdr windows
preprocessing.image: TorchSig Models YOLO adapter pattern: per-image min-max scale to uint8, grayscale replicated to BGR, invert to black-hot
preprocessing.coordinate_mapping: detector x pixels map to time frames and descending y pixels map to ascending frequency bins, including frequency tiles, then to Hz/time
preprocessing.status: experimental; upstream release does not publish exact checkpoint training FFT configuration

runtime: Ultralytics package and model licensing terms apply separately; no weights are auto-downloaded
